security.lockExplain: Protects the app with a password on opening. Your data is only on this device anyway – the lock prevents anyone who picks up the device from seeing your accounts.
security.rememberWarning: Important: remember your password well. Without it you can only get back in via a reset (deletes data) or a backup.
security.confirmRemove: Really remove the app lock? The app will then be accessible without a password.

lock.enterPassword: Enter password to access your accounts.
lock.forgotExplain: For security there is no password reset that keeps your data. You can only start over (deletes all local data) – or restore a backup afterwards, if available.
lock.confirmReset: Reset app? This deletes ALL local data on this device (transactions, receipts, settings). Only continue if you have a backup or want to start over.

onboarding.subtitle: Your private accounting (EÜR) – entirely on your device.
onboarding.dataBody: All transactions are stored only locally in this browser, on this device. There is no server – no one but you can see them.
onboarding.backupBody: Because the data is only local, there is no automatic cloud backup. Export a backup in the settings from time to time (optionally password-protected) and keep it safe.
onboarding.scanBody: For AI receipt recognition, add your own Anthropic API key in the settings. The app works fully without a key – only the automatic scan is unavailable (local text recognition still works).
onboarding.lockTitle: Protect the app with a password (optional)

disclaimer.title: Quick note first
disclaimer.p1: This app is a private organization and overview tool for your income and expenses following the EÜR principle – not certified GoBD accounting software.
disclaimer.p2: For your tax return, exporting the data and coordinating with your tax advisor or ELSTER remain authoritative. Moving from Germany to Spain (tax residency, double-taxation treaties, §19a EU rule) is fiscally complex – the app structures your data by country but does not replace tax advice.
disclaimer.p3: All data stays local on your device. AI functions use your own Anthropic API key; receipts are then sent to Anthropic for analysis.
